CustomField.description: The name of the Apex class that handles this service, such as API_Handler or MyNamespace.API_Handler. When an incoming request is routed by its path, a name without a namespace takes the namespace of this setting record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Apex class name of the API handler. For an incoming route, a name without a namespace takes the namespace of this setting record.
CustomField.label: Class Name
